CPM-BULL Strategy Dashboard

CPM (canary-gated momentum + min-variance pair selection) + BULL-QQQ trend overlay.

Backtest window: 2007-02-28 to 2026-05-18 | Built: 2026-05-18

Bottom line

Production deployment: 70% CPM defensive sleeve + 30% BULL-QQQ bull sleeve (oracle-v3 Sharpe-optimal).

CPM (Canary-gated Pair Momentum) = 11-asset cross-asset universe (factor + sector + international + diversifier), HYG+TIP+GLD any-positive canary, min-variance pair selection on top-K Faber SMA ranker, vol cap 10% (de-risk only, no leverage), 10 bps/side cost.

BULL-QQQ = QQQ (or XLP in `+-+` canary state) when composite trend (QQQ 12-1 mom > 0 OR QQQ 13612W > 0) passes AND (HYG/LQD/TIP any-positive canary OR equity-strength override: QQQ 12-1 mom > top tercile of expanding history). Otherwise 100% SHV cash.

Live-18y backtest (post-cost): CPM standalone Sharpe 1.26, CAGR 12.12%, MaxDD -13.5%. BULL-QQQ standalone Sharpe ~1.07, CAGR ~18%, MaxDD ~-29%. 70/30 production blend Sharpe ~1.48, CAGR ~14.25%, MaxDD ~-12.3%, COVID DD ~-2%. Extended 32y window (incl. dot-com): Sharpe ~1.27, CAGR ~13.2%, MaxDD ~-15.2%. TEST OOS 2017-26: Sharpe 1.63, CAGR 16.85%. Bootstrap 95% CI on Sharpe is wide, so honest forward base-case expectation is 0.90-1.20 Sharpe, 8-12% CAGR after in-sample selection bias and Nasdaq-era discount.

Canary Regime History

CPM canary (HYG/TIP/GLD any-positive 13612U): Risk-on 90.5% (210/232) -- pair selection runs. Defensive 9.5% (22/232) -- 100% SHV cash. Defensive fires only when ALL three of HYG (credit), TIP (inflation), GLD (real-asset/tail) are simultaneously negative. GLD added (vs original HYG+TIP) to avoid TLT-bias when canary triggers in rate-rising regimes.

BULL canary (HYG/LQD/TIP any-positive 13612U + QQQ trend): QQQ on 81.5% (189/232), XLP late-cycle 4.3% (10/232, HYG-/LQD-/TIP+ state only), cash 14.2% (33/232). Uses LQD instead of GLD because bull-overlay's lone-GLD-positive states have -2.3% mean forward QQQ (canary differentiation documented in caveat 7).

The two canaries differ by sleeve design: CPM uses HYG/TIP/GLD (real-asset focus, suits cross-asset pair selection); BULL-QQQ uses HYG/LQD/TIP (credit/inflation focus, suits single-asset equity overlay). HYG_stitched = VWEHX pre-2007-04 + live HYG.

Strategy Spec

CPM Sleeve (70%)
  • Universe (9): 4 US broad/factor (QQQ, IWF, VBR, SPHQ) + EFA (iShares developed, live 2001-08), EEM (iShares EM, live 2003-04) + GLD, TLT, DBC (diversifiers). Live-trade equivalents: IWF→SCHG (corr 0.994, 14bps cheaper), DBC→PDBC (no K-1). EFA/EEM chosen over VEA/VWO on principle (correlation >0.99, picking the +0.05 Sh winner is DSR overfitting; EFA has 6y more live history). DBMF (managed futures) tested and rejected -- year-by-year analysis showed entire benefit came from a single year (2024) with zero contribution in 2022. Canonical window: 2007-02-28 (19.2y, post-DBC + 12mo signal warmup, all 9 RISKY ETFs LIVE at start, includes full 2008 GFC realization) -- only HYG canary uses VWEHX stitch pre-2007-04 (existing established proxy); prior 2008-09 cherry-picked post-GFC-trough start.
    QQQ, IWF, VBR, SPHQ, EFA, EEM, GLD, TLT, DBC
  • Safe pool: SHV (best-of by Faber 10m SMA distance)
  • Canary: HYG + TIP, ANY positive Keller 13612W > 0 -> risk-on; both negative -> 100% best safe. HYG_stitched = VWEHX pre-2007-04 + live HYG.
  • Ranker: Faber 10-month SMA distance: (price - SMA10) / SMA10
  • Selection: top half by ranker, drop negative momentum
  • Pair: minimum-variance pair (50/50 portfolio variance) among positive-momentum candidates (756d lookback)
  • Hold buffer: 2.5 z-units (keep prior pair member unless new exceeds)
  • Vol targeting: 10% annualized, 63d realized vol, max 1.0x (de-risk only, no leverage)
  • Cost: 10 bps/side
  • Execution: month-end signal, T+1 MOC trade
BULL-QQQ Sleeve (30%) - bull capture with cash defense
  • Bull asset: QQQ (single ticker -- Nasdaq-100, already diversified across mega-cap tech). Multi-ETF "diversified" universes (SMH/SCHG/XLK/IWM/GLD) tested and rejected: same Sharpe, more complexity, no alpha.
  • Per-asset filter: QQQ 12-1 absolute momentum > 0 (Antonacci dual momentum / Moskowitz TSMOM). Chosen over Faber 10mo SMA because dot-com survival is materially better -- 12-1 stays negative throughout sustained bears, avoiding whipsaws.
  • Macro gate: HYG OR TIP positive 13612W (catches credit/inflation stress, e.g. 2022). Adds +54% Martin Ratio over mom-only at small CAGR cost.
  • Fallback: 100% SHV (short-treasury cash) when either filter fails. No duration risk on this sleeve.
  • Standalone (live-18y): Sharpe 0.92, CAGR 15.3%, MaxDD -28.6%, Ulcer 5.05%, Martin 2.96.
  • Why this composition: canary catches credit/inflation stress (2022); 12-1 momentum catches sustained equity bears (dot-com 2000-02). Together they handle 2 of 3 bear-market types. Single-ticker QQQ chosen over multi-ETF "diversified" universes because empirical tests showed same Sharpe with more complexity.
  • Variants tested and rejected: Multi-ETF universe (no Sharpe benefit, more rotation noise); IEF fallback (+0.02 Sharpe but adds duration risk); CPM fallback (+0.85pp CAGR but worse Martin Ratio on extended); Faber 10mo SMA filter (worse dot-com survival); VIX filter (~0.05 Sharpe cost across both windows, n=1 COVID evidence); vol-targeting (cleaner MaxDD but minimal avg-rolling-DD improvement, trades CAGR for tail protection); Keller 13612W filter (Sh 0.76 worst on QQQ timing); EMA50/200 monthly (math error - 4yr/17yr filter, useless); top-K momentum-weighted (concentrates on highest vol, hurts Sharpe).

Honest Caveats

  • In-sample selection bias: hyperparameters and universe tuned on this same data window.
  • Universe risk: 7-name US equity sub-universe is bespoke / human-curated. All ETFs live since 2005 or earlier; no SPY-proxy contamination in post-2008 backtest.
  • Pre-2019 proxies: SPHQ uses SPY proxy pre-2005, DBMF uses SG CTA Index pre-2019 (affects EXT 30y window only; MODERN 17.6y window has all ETFs live except DBMF which uses CTA stitch).
  • Crisis-concentrated alpha: top 4 single years (2008 +45.8pp, 2002 +32.8pp, 2020 +17.6pp, 2022 +17.2pp) contribute +128pp of total +25pp arithmetic excess vs SPY. Non-crisis years generally lag SPY.
  • Lags V-shaped recoveries (verified): 2009 full-year -10.8pp vs SPY; 2020-Q2 -27.6pp vs SPY in the snap-back. Canary slow to re-engage after deep selloffs.
  • Bullish-rally underperformance is structural: MAX_LEVERAGE=1.0 prevents the vol-target from levering up in low-vol bull runs. Strategy gives up bull upside in exchange for crisis alpha as designed.
  • Bootstrap CI for Sharpe (live-only 18y): CPM standalone Sharpe 1.29, 95% CI [0.78, 1.63] (pre-canary-upgrade CI bounds; will narrow once new HYG canary has more data). Wide CIs imply ~0.21 std-error on forward estimate. Anchor forward base case at 0.80-1.10 for CPM standalone.
  • Strategy not yet live-traded. Forward expectation should anchor below backtest.
